subject: L2_TRIO_MARKET_RESIDUAL_V3
purpose: Stress-test whether the observed V3 improvement over pure TRIO market is stable rather than a narrow or accidental effect. This audit must not tune the production rule from test-year outcomes.
primary_question: Does the frozen prior-selected L1.75 residual correction improve race-level probability quality versus pure normalized TRIO market across 2023-2025?

primary_rule.pooled_cluster_bootstrap: 95% CI upper bound for mean race logloss delta < 0
primary_rule.year_cluster_bootstrap: At least 2 of 3 yearly 95% CI upper bounds < 0
primary_rule.note: The audit reports this rule mechanically and does not redefine it after seeing results.

alpha_sensitivity.selection: Alpha remains selected from strict-prior calibration only.
alpha_sensitivity.interpretation: Test-grid results are descriptive robustness evidence and must not replace the prior-selected alpha.

ablations.NO_OUTSIDER: Neutralize Outsider score, p3 calibration/delta/alignment and availability features.
ablations.NO_SEVEN_KING: Neutralize Seven-King ranking/probability/support/dispersion, rank-gap/dissent, and King-calibrated p3 signals while retaining market-context and raw independent Outsider score where available.

operational_caveat: Historical final TRIO and WIN odds are research proxies. Production requires timestamped pre-race odds and must be revalidated separately.
